summary: Run only MinerPass v2 with atomic block recovery and mint audit queries
details: Remove legacy MinerPass execution. Rust and Go accept only the implemented v2 inscription-schema/state-machine pair, while preserving scoped registries, height checkpoints and state identities for future upgrades. Legacy catalogs keep their immutable IDs but cannot authorize execution; an explicitly selected isolated regtest catalog supports development validation.

Run v2 mints through the production event planner and tracker using canonical block discovery, actual sat/source evidence and transaction-order balances. Missing or inconsistent evidence aborts and retries the entire block rather than publishing a permanent Invalid.
Recover energy and tracker caches from committed SQLite after outer block publication fails, and gate subsequent blocks while recovery remains incomplete.

Add the optional get_pass_mint_audit RPC and rebuildable audit storage, published and rolled back with pass state. Reads verify the selected committed block and reveal anchor; v2 records missing audit report data errors. Audit is auxiliary and does not change mutation encoding or economic query, state-view and upstream balance-history versions.

Control-plane now emits v2 JSON. Full source/recipient wallet flows and live Core/AssumeUTXO qualification remain separate work. No existing network bundle, chain configuration or online service is reset by this change.
operator_actions: Do not upgrade an existing V1 dataset in place. Prepare a fresh development network with an explicitly pinned V2 rules scope/catalog and matching Go chain configuration; freeze the reset network bundle separately before deployment.
